embedding.preprocessing: server /v2/embed, input_type query|document, truncate END; mean pooling; first 1024 of 4096 dims, re-normalised

config.asOf: none (asOf filters validity, not relative-date anchoring; validFrom and validTo are null)
config.gpuRequestDeadline: No extra adapter wall-clock deadline through the shared proxy; window budget and VM cutoff remain

transportRetry: Common proxy: ECONNRESET only, 3 total upstream attempts, 250/500ms backoff, identical payload; HTTP errors unchanged; native client retries remain; upstream keep-alive disabled
